# terrakube_registry_provider_version (Resource)

A version of a provider that you host in the private registry. Add the downloads for it with `terrakube_registry_provider_implementation`. A provider mirrored from the public registry (`imported = true`) gets its versions from Terrakube, so this resource is for providers you build yourself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_registry_provider" "internal" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "internal"
}

resource "terrakube_registry_provider_version" "current" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  provider_id     = data.terrakube_registry_provider.internal.id
  version_number  = "1.2.3"
  protocols       = ["6.0"]
}

# Still served, with a warning (Terrakube 2.34.0+).
resource "terrakube_registry_provider_version" "old" {
  organization_id     = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  provider_id         = data.terrakube_registry_provider.internal.id
  version_number      = "1.0.0"
  protocols           = ["5.0"]
  status              = "deprecated"
  deprecation_message = "Use 1.2.3 or later"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `protocols` (List of String) Plugin protocol versions the provider supports, for example `["6.0"]`. Providers built with the Terraform plugin framework use `6.0`, and ones built with SDKv2 use `5.0`. The registry cannot serve a version without them.
- `provider_id` (String) ID of the `terrakube_registry_provider` this is a version of. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `version_number` (String) Version, for example `1.2.3`. Changing this forces a new resource, so a new version is created.

### Optional

- `deprecation_message` (String) Shown with a deprecated or removed version, for example when it will go or what to upgrade to. One line of up to 1024 UTF-16 code units (an emoji counts as two). Terrakube 2.34.0+.
- `status` (String) `active`, `deprecated` (still served, with a warning) or `removed` (no longer served). Removing it from the configuration sets it back to `active`. Terrakube 2.34.0+.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Version ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Registry provider version can be imported with organization_id,provider_id,id
terraform import terrakube_registry_provider_version.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
